description: This file contains unit tests for the VacancyListRestController class within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It verifies the REST API endpoints for listing vacancies, handling different query parameters, and ensures that unimplemented HTTP methods throw the appropriate exceptions.

classes.name: VacancyListRestControllerTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the VacancyListRestController's API endpoints related to vacancy listing and request handling within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures before any tests are run, loading vacancy data from a YAML fixture file.

methods.name: testHandleGetRequest
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of vacancy list with default parameters, verifying a specific vacancy name.

methods.name: testHandleGetRequestCount
methods.description: Tests that the vacancy list endpoint returns 5 items, verifying the count.

methods.name: testHandleGetRequestWithLimit
methods.description: Tests the vacancy list endpoint with a limit parameter, expecting 2 results.

methods.name: testHandleGetRequestWithOffset
methods.description: Tests the vacancy list endpoint with an offset parameter, verifying the first vacancy name.

methods.name: testHandlePutRequest
methods.description: Ensures that calling handlePutRequest throws a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: testInitPutValidationRule
methods.description: Ensures that initPutValidationRule throws a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: testHandlePostRequest
methods.description: Ensures that handlePostRequest throws a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: testInitPostValidationRule
methods.description: Ensures that initPostValidationRule throws a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: testHandleDeleteRequest
methods.description: Ensures that handleDeleteRequest throws a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: testInitDeleteValidationRule
methods.description: Ensures that initDeleteValidationRule throws a NotImplementedException.
